cover: Build or buy: when custom software beats SaaS

slides.title: Buy when the work is the same everywhere
slides.body: Payroll, email and accounting are solved problems. The vendor has already met the edge cases you haven't.

slides.title: A spreadsheet sits beside the tool
slides.body: When people keep one open to do the part the tool can't, you're already running a second system by hand.

slides.title: Count every cost, not the subscription
slides.body: Migration, seats as you hire, renewal increases, hours on workarounds, and what it would cost to leave.

slides.title: Buy the standard parts, build your own
slides.body: Keep the tools that work and build a thin layer for what's specific to you, connected through their APIs.

slides.title: Check the exit before you sign
slides.body: Make sure the tool has a decent API and lets you export your data, even if you have no plans to build yet.
